scenes.visualIntent: Problem-first hook transitioning from Treasury delivery to short-rate hedging and duration
keyElements: Eurodollar and SOFR futures dominate global short-rate volume
Contracts cover 3-month rates on $1,000,000 notional principal
Part 2 links rate adjustments directly to bond duration hedging

scenes.visualIntent: Teach 100 - R price quotation and $25 value per basis point per contract
keyElements: Contract price quote equals 100 minus annualized 3-month rate R
Index quote 95.00 implies 5.00% annualized 3-month interest
Each 1 basis point move equals exactly $25 per contract

scenes.visualIntent: Misconception split showing how daily variation margin reinvestment splits futures from forwards
keyElements: Daily variation margin settles futures profits immediately every day
Short futures earn cash wins when rates surge and reinvest higher
Favorable daily reinvestment makes futures rates exceed forward rates

scenes.visualIntent: Deconstruct ForwardRate = FuturesRate - 0.5 * sigma^2 * T1 * T2
keyElements: Convexity Adjustment converts raw futures rates to forward rates
Deduction grows quadratically with rate volatility sigma
Long horizons T1 * T2 make convexity gaps material past 2 years

scenes.visualIntent: Causal chain stripping adjusted Eurodollar and SOFR futures into zero curves
keyElements: Treasury bonds run thin between 2 and 10 years, so futures fill gaps
Convexity deduction converts quarterly futures quotes to forwards
Continuous bootstrap extends zero discount curves accurately

scenes.visualIntent: Deconstruct N* = (P * DP) / (FC * DF) matching portfolio dollar duration
keyElements: Dollar duration equals market value multiplied by duration
Duration hedge matches portfolio sensitivity to CTD futures bond
Higher portfolio duration demands more short futures contracts

scenes.visualIntent: Solve Hull's $10,000,000 corporate bond duration hedge requiring short 79 contracts
keyElements: $10,000,000 portfolio at 6.80y carries $68,000,000 dollar duration
$93,187.50 futures with 9.20y CTD carries $857,325 duration
Ratio 79.32 contracts rounds to shorting 79 futures contracts

scenes.visualIntent: Illustrate Asset-Liability Management immunization using interest rate futures
keyElements: Banks hold long fixed loans funded by short customer deposits
Positive duration gap exposes bank equity to rising yields
ALM committees short interest futures to close balance-sheet gaps

scenes.visualIntent: Contrast ideal parallel shifts against real curve steepening, credit spreads, and CTD shifts
keyElements: Duration hedges assume uniform parallel yield curve shifts
Curve steepening or inversion breaks single-factor protection
Corporate credit spreads and CTD switches leave residual basis

scenes.visualIntent: 3-beat quiz sizing N* for $50M portfolio (5.0y duration) vs $100,000 contract (8.0y CTD)
keyElements: $50M portfolio at 5.0y duration carries $250M dollar duration
$100,000 contract at 8.0y CTD carries $800,000 duration
Hedge ratio 312.50 rounds cleanly to short 313 contracts

scenes.visualIntent: Synthesize Chapter 6 short-rate & duration hedging and bridge forward to Chapter 7 Swaps
keyElements: Convexity Adjustment converts 5-10 year futures into zero curves
Duration hedge N* immunizes bond portfolios and bank ALM gaps
Chapter 7 next covers Interest Rate Swaps & Comparative Advantage

scenes.visualIntent: Fixed 6-beat summary codifying all 8 rules taught in Chapter 6 Part 2
keyElements: 100 - R futures move $25 per basis point on $1,000,000
Subtract Convexity Adjustment before extending zero curves
Duration hedge N* matches dollar duration across portfolios
